E00.title: Mission briefing
E00.description: Explore Taurus–Littrow, observe Apollo heritage from a distance, collect two geological samples and return to base within six simulated hours.

choices.label: Begin mission
choices.description: Acknowledge the objectives and enter the airlock.

E01.title: Suit up for the surface
E01.description: Before leaving the airlock, choose how to prepare your suit and yourself for the traverse.

choices.label: Complete equipment check
choices.description: Inspect seals, battery and life support before departure.

choices.label: Quick preparation
choices.description: Leave the airlock sooner with fewer equipment checks.

choices.label: Rest before departure
choices.description: Take extra recovery time and carry out a brief suit inspection.

E02.title: Choose your traverse
E02.description: Two routes approach the Apollo 17 rover observation point. The ridge is shorter, with a steeper grade.

choices.label: Difficult and short route
choices.description: Cross the rocky ridge toward the observation perimeter.

choices.label: Easy and longer route
choices.description: Follow the gentler valley terrain toward the same perimeter.

E03.title: Apollo heritage in sight
E03.description: Your optics have located the final parking area of Apollo 17’s Lunar Roving Vehicle. Log the observation while remaining outside the heritage perimeter.

choices.label: Log rover discovery
choices.description: Survey the vehicle remotely. Fatigue rises as the surface shift progresses.

E05.title: Fatigue incident
E05.description: Mission Control requests a recovery decision after the extended surface survey. Compare the current telemetry with your return reserves.

choices.label: Rest in a safe area
choices.description: Pause in a sheltered spot before attempting science operations.

choices.label: Continue the mission
choices.description: Proceed directly to the science site under elevated exertion.

choices.label: Return early
choices.description: Abort science operations and take the emergency shortcut directly to base.

E06.title: Collect geological samples
E06.description: The sample field lies outside the historical perimeter. Spend resources on the science objective or preserve them for the return.

choices.label: Collect two samples
choices.description: Collect basalt and regolith for the complete science objective.

choices.label: Collect one sample
choices.description: Collect a basalt specimen with less exposure and effort.

choices.label: Skip collection
choices.description: Preserve supplies and plan the return to base.

E07.title: Return to base
E07.description: Check suit reserves and physiological telemetry. The valley route reduces exertion, while the direct route saves time.

choices.label: Direct return route
choices.description: Take the steeper shortcut. If return limits are exceeded, this attempt triggers rescue.

choices.label: Safer return route
choices.description: Follow the sheltered valley corridor. If return limits are exceeded, this attempt triggers rescue.
